title: RAHHH
blurb: Primal, wordless, and somehow expressing peak hype, peak rage and peak patriotism at once. There is no content here at all. It is pure intensity with the meaning left to context, so it turns up over gym personal bests, game-winning plays, and edits involving an eagle and a flag with roughly equal frequency. Grammar is optional. Volume is not. Press the button and let the intrusive hype win, ideally somewhere you will not have to explain yourself afterwards. Nobody in the history of the internet has ever said this quietly.
origin: The viral maximum-intensity scream of hype culture.
